services.name: Destin sunset cruise
services.desc: What could be better than embracing the magic of a Destin sunset cruise on our state-of-the-art power catamaran? Every Thursday night gets even more unforgettable as fireworks light up the sky over Destin Harbor after sunset! Bring your favorite drinks aboard and sip as you watch the vibrant colors of the Destin sunset paint the sky while we cruise through the Harbor toward the perfect fireworks viewing spot. Glide across crystal-clear waters and take in the beauty of Destin from the water. services.name: Dolphin & Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Come explore and discover two of nature’s most beautiful treasures on one exciting adventure with Crab Island Company. Grab your seat on our 45′ Corinthian catamaran, a spacious and comfortable catamaran with all the conveniences, including modern marine restrooms, so that you can enjoy your adventure. Our first stop is the shimmering seas of the Gulf of Mexico, just outside the East Pass and only minutes from Crab island, where some of Destin’s most adored locals live. The bottlenose dolphins call these waters their home, and once we get to the ideal spot, we’ll responsibly observe these gentle creatures. Watch in awe as they gracefully swim, playfully jump and do what comes naturally.
